reader.requirement: At --std 85 RELEASE record-name-1 must be a level-01 logical record of an SD (any of its record descriptions), optionally qualified; an FD record, a working-storage item, a subordinate item, a reference-modified record or a file-name is refused.
reader.edition-search: grep of Edition.Edition / DialectLevel / ConstructRegistry / DialectBehaviors in SortBinder.cs and StatementValidation.cs: BindRelease's only consults are DialectLevel < 2002 (rangeFailsStatement, a general-rule outcome for out-of-range record sizes) and the FROM-literal gate; neither is on the SR1 path; ResolveRecordName and CheckReleaseRecord consult no edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the 85 witness is the qualified acceptance; the refusals (FD record, WS item, subordinate item, refmod) are witnessed only by cases not run at 85

probes.printed: EXIT 0: R OF S1, RB (second 01), R IN S1 released; output AA111 BB222 CC333
probes.expected: accepted: qualified and secondary records are both legal

probes.printed: COBOL1757: FR is a record of F1, which is described by an FD
COBOL1757: WR is not a logical record of any file description entry
COBOL1757: K OF R OF S1 is subordinate to R
COBOL1639: R is not unique without qualification
COBOL1639: S1 is a file-name, not a data item

citations.check: OK  §1985:XI.4.2.3 SR1  (4.2.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1 [Record-name-1 must be the name of a logical record in a sort-merge file description entry and it may be qualified]

reader.notes: Both halves of SR1 are checked at bind time, with no edition fork. The diagnostics cite §2023:14.9.32.3 SR1 at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: x3f (66 RR RENAMES K THRU D under the SD, RELEASE RR) refused COBOL1757 (subordinate to R); x3g (RELEASE of an 88 condition-name under the SD record) refused COBOL1639; x3h (SD RECORD IS VARYING 3 TO 6 DEPENDING ON L, record with OCCURS 1 TO 4 DEPENDING ON N, RELEASE R and RELEASE R OF S1) compiles and returns R AA L=3 / R BB L=4. Reader covered FD record, WS item, subordinate, refmod, file-name, ambiguity. (A first probe x3/x3d that used the ODO count as the RECORD DEPENDING length released out-of-range sizes, which at 85 fail the statement: my program's error, a general-rule outcome, not SR1.) cite.py: OK  §1985:XI.4.2.3 SR1 [Record-name-1 must be the name of a logical record in a sort-merge file description entry].
